title: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic

comments.text: Syntax comment: the docstring of get_failure_reason misspells 'human' as 'humam' (also 'readible'). A suggested change fixes the spelling.

Logic comment: get_monitor_environment_context uses monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the modified local config variable, so the schedule_type transformation is discarded. A suggested change returns config instead.
